payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates positions from right to left, using DP to choose whether to take an occurrence (if valid) and update max beauty and min replacements. Sliding window efficiently tracks match/mismatch counts.
payload.rationale: The DP state is 1D (position) storing (max beauty, min replacements). Transitions decide between skipping or taking t. The sliding window updates match counts in O(1). This aligns with dp_1d_state.
